newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Zim Israel starts south China-U.S. freight service.
newsitem.headline: Zim Israel starts south China-U.S. freight service.

text.p: Zim Israel Navigation Co said it has launched a fixed-day weekly container freight service between Shekou port, south China, and the United States.
Zim said the service, aimed at clients in the developing area of the Pearl River Delta in south China, is the only direct service from Shekou to the United States.
Zim, one of the world's largest container shipping companies, is 51 percent controlled by the Israel Corp with the remaining shares owned by the Israeli government.
